title: Confirm the team label appears on your metrics

blocks.content: Cost attribution uses labels that already exist on your telemetry. In this milestone, you query your metrics in Explore to confirm that the `team` label is present before you configure attribution.
To query metrics by team, complete the following steps:
Make sure the Prometheus data source for your stack is selected. Its name follows the pattern `grafanacloud-STACK_SLUG-prom`.
Switch to **Code** mode to write queries directly.
Enter a query that counts the collectors that report metrics for each `team` value.
Click **Run query** to see the results.

The results show one series for each `team`, for example `{team="payments-platform"}`. The value is the number of collectors that send metrics for that team.

If no series appear, wait a few minutes for the collectors to poll Fleet Management and apply the pipeline. If you still see no `team` label, check that:

- The pipeline is active and matches your collectors.
- The collectors have a `team` attribute.
- The `GCLOUD_RW_API_KEY` environment variable is set on the collectors.

In the next milestone, you configure `team` as a cost attribution label.
